headword: {現代美術|げんだいびじゅつ}

definitions.explanation: The art of the present day, usually meaning art made since the mid-20th century, including installation, video and conceptual work as well as painting and sculpture.

examples.japanese: {現代美術|げんだいびじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧。
{現代美術|げんだいびじゅつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧わからない。
examples.english: I don't really understand contemporary art.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金沢|かなざわ}→金沢：31890_kanazawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{現代美術館|げんだいびじゅつかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{子|こ}ども⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: The museum of contemporary art in Kanazawa is popular for its many works that children can enjoy too.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現代美術館|げんだいびじゅつかん}: museum of contemporary art
- {現代美術|げんだいびじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: contemporary artist
- {現代美術|げんだいびじゅつ}⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧: contemporary art exhibition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {近代美術|きんだいびじゅつ}: modern art, roughly from the mid-19th to the mid-20th century; {現代美術|げんだいびじゅつ} is what came after
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦アート→アート：10713_aato⟧: the same thing in more casual, trendy wording
